area: the Ark escort and the Arkway banner
summary: The Arkway banner (ArkwayVoyageHud) is now the voyage's toast: Rev 113 band, a mood (event/threat/good), a line under it, one at a time. The escort's banners carry moods (fallen and overrun red, through green), its assaults' lines too, it feeds the objective box (ArkEscortRun.Hud.cs), and its end shows the scoreboard with Venture further / Finish / Try again.
why: Milestone 1 in-voyage HUD and scoreboard (Shombith, 2026-11-16); Prompt 1 said reuse the banner path rather than add a second toast system.
